sanskrit:
अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः ।
भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः ॥ १०-५॥
iast:
ahiṃsā samatā tuṣṭistapo dānaṃ yaśo’yaśaḥ
bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ 10-5
translation: Non-injury, equanimity, contentment, austerity, beneficence, fame, infamy — all these different kinds of qualities-of-beings arise from Me alone.
